d:
Vaishali jile ke kachchi dargah-bidupur siksalen mahasetu ka nam apne nam par 'nitish setu' rakhe jane ko lekar jab midiya ne purv mukhyamantri aur jadyu ke rashtriy adhyaksh nitish kumar se pratikriya mangi, to unhonne hath jor liya aur bina koee javab die aage barh gae. unka yah andaj vahan maujud logon aur rajnitik galiyaron men charcha ka vishay bana huaa hai.
Rajapakar ke banghara ganv pahunche the nitish kumar, midiya ke saval par sadhi chuppi
